A statement is followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. An assumption is something supposed or taken for granted. You have to consider the statement and the following assumptions and decide which of the assumptions is implicit/valid in the statement.Statement: This course book is prepared in a manner that even a layman can learn basic mathematics in the absence of any teacher.Assumption:I. This course book is a good substitute for mathematics teacher.II. A layman, generally needs a teacher to learn any subject.
options: Both Assumptions I and II are valid.
Neither Assumption I nor II is valid.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only Assumption I is valid.) है।
